missing.basis: Frames lower spending as tax relief ('When government spends less, there's more money left in your pocket') [S1] and lists 'increasing taxes' among the problems county residents face [S5]. No specific tax position or pledge, and the auditor sets no taxes, so low.

Cites 'responsible stewardship of public resources' [S1] and backs consolidating elections to once a year on cost grounds, noting an April fire district election cost the district $36,000 versus barely $1,000 at a primary or general [S7]. Generic stewardship language plus one cost-saving proposal, so low; milder than Shogren's -2.
